title: DSWD Philippines' Municipality Tropical Cyclone Dataset

contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: The dataset comprises observations of building damage due to tropical cyclones in the Philippines at the municipality level. It includes 39 cyclone events. The dataset consists of variables representing the characteristics of cyclone events experienced by each municipality, secondary hazard proxies (e.g., landslides, and storm surges), and vulnerability variables represented by building typologies.
